===Noun===
{{wp|checkers}}
{{en-noun|-}}

# {{lb|en|board games|UK|Irish|Commonwealth|uncountable}} A [[board]] [[game]] for two [[player]]s in which the players each have a set number of pieces (typically 12 or 20, depending on the rule set), known as ''[[man|men]]'', and the [[object]] is to [[capture]] each of the [[opponent]]'s pieces by jumping one's own pieces over the opponent's pieces.
#: {{syn|en|checkers<q:US, Canada>}}
#: {{hypo|en|Turkish draughts}}
#: {{mero|en|draughtsman}}
# A mild [[vesicatory]].
